purpose: Windows UIA Designer structural command focus, history, and stable-ID save/reopen round-trip

windows.a11y_job: a11y-bridge completed successfully, including live UIA window smoke

local.acceptance_markers: dpi_theme, theme_reference, structure_edit, edit_save_reopen, and window smoke markers are each unique and required

limitations: The UIA client loop verifies structural command focus, history, and persistence through a real HWND, but does not provide a signed-in desktop keyboard, drag, or screen-reader acceptance record.

Real drag reorder, Narrator/NVDA/Orca/VoiceOver speech, IME, cross-application clipboard, inspector overlays, GPU recovery, clean-machine packaging, and one-hour soak remain separate manual platform checks.
